How This Calculator Works

1. Pepper's Unique Loading Formula
NAF = Finance Amount + All Financed Fees
Commission = Dollar amount entered (not added to principal)
Loading = (NAF ÷ (NAF + Commission)) × (1 - 0.4 × Financier Rate)
Amount Financed = NAF + (Loading × Commission)

The 0.4 loading factor is unique to Pepper. Commission is NOT added directly to principal - it's serviced by the interest margin.

2. Monthly Payment Calculation
PMT (Arrears) = (Amount Financed - PV_balloon) × [r(1+r)^n] ÷ [(1+r)^n - 1]
PMT (Advance) = PMT Arrears ÷ (1 + Monthly Rate)

Payment is calculated on the "Amount Financed" at the financier rate.

3. Comparison Rate Calculation
Comparison Rate = The rate that, applied to NAF alone, produces the same payment
We solve: PMT(NAF, comparison_rate, term, balloon) = Calculated Payment

The comparison rate is the "true cost" from the customer's perspective.

4. Key Insight
Financier Rate: 7.75% → What lender charges on Amount Financed
Comparison Rate: 9.40% → Effective rate customer experiences on NAF
Loading Factor: 0.932 → Only 93.2% of commission impacts payment

The broker receives full commission, but it's serviced through the interest margin rather than being added to principal.
